fact: The paper states that Tanzania has 20,763 registered primary schools and that 15,872,709 pupils in grades one to seven are registered through the electronic PReM student records system (citing NECTA, 2023).
title: Assessing the Performance of Primary School Information Management Systems (PReM) in Data Provision: A Focus on Two Selected Public Primary Schools at Temeke Municipal Council, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania
